## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or analytics capability you would like to see in Nolyvatix.

## 💡 Problem Statement / Motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation in existing blockchain analytics tools?
*Example: "I'm frustrated when analyzing Soroban WASM contract gas consumption because..."*

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this working from a user perspective:
- What view or component would this feature live in?
- What raw Stellar Horizon or Soroban RPC endpoints are required?
- What charts or visualizations would best represent this data?

## 📊 Mockups / UI Ideas

If applicable, add visual sketches, wireframes, or reference screenshots from other BI platforms.

## ➕ Additional Context or References

Add any other context, Stellar Improvement Proposals (CAPs/SEPs), or documentation links here.
